method.input: Same decoded local photos, EXIF-normalized/max960px, per-engine original crop/matching.
method.dataset: Three known enrollment photos; two independent held-out known photos; two unseen people; in-memory blank/two-face controls; 20 correlated stress derivatives and 2 legacy diagnostic portraits reported separately. Legacy filenames are not ground truth.
method.reference_stock_enrollment: First enrollment crop encoded three times, as shipped.
method.reference_distinct_experiment: Three different enrollment crops; experimental setup, not shipped UI.
method.latency: Image decode excluded; actual detection/crop/encoding/matching included; fresh camera geometry per probe, no preview cache speedup. Single inference plus source history helper, not elapsed three-camera-frame confirmation.
method.scores: SFace cosine and dlib/fallback Euclidean distances are not comparable numbers.
method.scope: Small, one enrolled identity; no full-school accuracy, multi-roster ambiguity, physical camera or native Vercel claims.
method.python_runtime: Shared314 runs reuse supplied binary dependencies with public dlib models in ASCII temporary path. Production312 current measured separately. No dependency changed in Django env.
